components.name: AcceptQuoteRow
components.role: "Updated price · 1,240.55 USDC (-1.42%) · [Accept]": shown when a refreshed quote moved enough that the amounts above are held and dimmed until the user takes it.

props.name: value

props.name: changeText

components.name: AmountInput
components.role: The large amount field: optional prefix, the input with its font shrinking to fit, an optional suffix.

props.name: value
props.doc: Caller-owned, display-ready: locale separators already applied (replaceSeparators).

props.name: onChangeValue
props.doc: The text as typed.

props.name: placeholder
props.doc: Default `0`.

props.name: prefix
props.doc: Before the amount at the same size and color, e.g. the fiat symbol in fiat mode.

props.name: suffix
props.doc: After the amount in a dimmer color, e.g. the token symbol.

props.name: fontSizeRange
props.doc: The font shrinks between these to fit the field.

props.name: fontSize
props.doc: A size the host computes itself, e.g. the old stepped sizing that measures the field once and holds the last size while the field is empty and unfocused.

props.name: onFieldLayout
props.doc: Layout of the field the amount fills, prefix excluded, for a host that computes `fontSize`.

props.name: onPressDisabled
props.doc: A press on the disabled input, e.g. explaining why exact output is unavailable.

props.name: showSoftInputOnFocus
props.doc: Native: `false` (default) keeps the soft keyboard down while the host's decimal pad types into the field.

props.name: selection
props.doc: Native only, caller-owned: where the decimal pad puts the caret.

props.name: inputRef
props.doc: For focus and blur.

props.name: animatedStyle
props.doc: Adapter-owned animation on the amount, the refetch pulse today.

components.name: AmountInputPresets
components.role: Percentage chips that fill the amount from the balance: 25%, 50%, 75%, Max.

props.name: onSelectPreset
props.doc: The host computes the amount for the percentage, as PresetAmountButton did.

props.name: onPressDisabledPreset
props.doc: A press on a disabled preset.

props.name: revealOnHover
props.doc: Hidden until the enclosing `group` is hovered, then staggered in.

props.name: revealFrom
props.doc: Where the staggered reveal starts: `start` under the amount, `end` when right-aligned in a header.

components.name: AutoPill
components.role: The small "Auto" badge shown when a setting (slippage, network cost) is on its automatic value.

props.name: label
props.doc: Generic copy, translated by the caller: the slippage and gas rows use different existing keys.

components.name: CurrencyInputPanel

props.name: label
props.doc: Product copy: "Sell", "Buy", "Budget".

props.name: token
props.doc: The selected token.

props.name: onPressSelectToken

props.name: tokenButton
props.doc: Token button look.

props.name: hasAmount
props.doc: An amount is entered.

props.name: fiatValue
props.doc: The other unit, formatted: `$1,234.56`, or the token amount in fiat mode.

props.name: onPressFiatValue
props.doc: The fiat line toggles fiat mode; the host decides, including when it cannot.

props.name: showFiatToggleIcon
props.doc: A ⇅ glyph before the fiat line, cueing that pressing it flips token and fiat entry (margin).

props.name: isBalanceInsufficient
props.doc: The amount exceeds the balance: amount and balance paint critical.

props.name: headerAccessory
props.doc: Slot: the label row's right edge, in place of header presets, e.g. margin's fiat quick-picks.

props.name: disabled
props.doc: Blocks typing; presses go to `onPressDisabled` (the adapter shakes the input row).

props.name: onPressIn
props.doc: A press on the panel or the input while a token is set, e.g. focusing this field.

props.name: tokenOptions
props.doc: Slot: quick-pick token chips for an empty output panel.

props.name: tokenOptionsPlacement
props.doc: `input` (default) replaces the `0`; `header` sits right of the label (desktop web).

props.name: accessory
props.doc: Slot: content under the input, e.g. the Toucan valuation slider.

props.name: variant
props.doc: `compact`: the Toucan bid inputs: smaller amount and lines, tighter rows.

props.name: card
props.doc: Paints the panel as a `$surface2` card.

props.name: inputRowAnimatedStyle
props.doc: Adapter-owned animation on the input row, the shake on a disabled press today.

props.name: accessible

components.name: DeadlineSettingValue

components.name: DetailRow
components.role: One label-left, value-right line: the rows inside transaction details on the form and review screens, and every hand-rolled `justifyContent="space-between"` row elsewhere (InfoRow, SummaryRow, KeyValueRow, MarginDetailRow, LiquidityModalDetailRows).

props.name: label
props.doc: Product copy.

props.name: value
props.doc: A string renders in the standard value style.

props.name: strikethroughValue
props.doc: Price before a discount, struck through ahead of `value` (UniswapX savings, sponsored gas).

props.name: caption
props.doc: One line of small print under the row, e.g. the smart wallet activation note under network cost.

props.name: isLoading
props.doc: Indicative quote with no value yet: the value renders as the loading skeleton.

props.name: fillValue
props.doc: The value takes all the space right of the label, so a pressable value (ExchangeRate) presses across it, like the old Rate row.

props.name: onPress
props.doc: Makes the whole row, caption included, one press target with a trailing chevron after the value, e.g. the network cost row that opens the gas editor.

components.name: ErrorView

props.name: title

props.name: primaryAction
props.doc: e.g. "Try again", or error-specific recovery copy.

props.name: onPressLearnMore
props.doc: Shows "Learn more" under the message.

components.name: ExchangeRate

props.name: rate

props.name: defaultInverted

props.name: styling

props.name: align

components.name: GasRow

props.name: leading

props.name: gasSummary
props.doc: Slot: the gas summary, normally GasSummary inside the adapter's network cost tooltip.

props.name: expanded

props.name: onExpandedChange

components.name: GasSummary

props.name: gasText

props.name: isHighRelativeToValue

components.name: IndicativeLoadingWrapper

components.name: NetworkCostRow

props.name: value

props.name: caption

components.name: ReviewSummary

props.name: title

props.name: input

props.name: onClose

components.name: SettingsRow

props.name: warning

props.name: value
props.doc: Right side.

props.name: onPress

components.name: SettingsRowList
